comments.author: Mr.Grandenigo
comments.body:
To be honest i tried it out during ESF and must say its worthless.
To be objective, yes, for melee it outclasses any small ship, but on the other hand, others used Gunboats, which were much faster, and killed npcs with cannons in few shots, before i could even get in close to the NPCs in time.
Plus the other thing - PVP in ESF. Not much PVP really going on in the small ship class, eh? So speed is primary here
